items.title: Use .Lattice baseline artifact root only
items.context: Remove dependency on .omx for this unlock run. Build or execute with artifactsRoot=.Lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock and ensure no new baseline proof artifact is written under .omx.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows no .omx directory was created for this unlock run and all Layer 2 proof paths are under .lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock.

happy.desc: Running formal baseline commands without a custom root uses .lattice/artifacts/baseline, not .omx/artifacts/baseline.

edge.desc: Explicit artifactsRoot=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock remains honored and produces no .omx output.

adversarial.desc: A scan after the run finds no newly-created .omx baseline artifacts for this story.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build and lattice baseline smoke passed after baseline default root changed to .lattice/artifacts/baseline.
CLI help reports .lattice/artifacts/baseline as the default baseline artifacts root.
No .omx directory exists in the worktree and formal baseline default/root wording no longer points at .omx.

items.title: Make local built CLI expose formal Layer2 commands
items.context: The source contains capability_claim_formal_evaluate but current dist/global CLI was stale. Build and verify node packages/main/dist/cli.js exposes capability_claim_formal_evaluate, baseline_run --formal, and baseline_suite_report --layer.
items.userSees: Terminal output from node packages/main/dist/cli.js help shows baseline_run --formal, baseline_suite_report --layer, and capability_claim_formal_evaluate are available.

happy.desc: After npm run build, node packages/main/dist/cli.js exposes capability_claim_formal_evaluate help successfully.

edge.desc: baseline_run --help documents --formal and proof refs after build.

adversarial.desc: A stale dist build no longer hides the formal Layer2 commands during verification.

verificationEvidence.note: Built CLI exposes capability_claim_formal_evaluate with target, claimId, artifactsRoot, writeReport, and output options.
Built CLI documents --formal plus suiteRunId, claimTarget, verificationEvidenceRefs, reviewEvidenceRefs, lifecycleGateEvidenceRefs, and receiptRefs.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_suite_report --help
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh build succeeded and built CLI documents baseline_suite_report --layer with .lattice artifact root, so verification is not using stale dist.

items.title: Materialize fresh Development lower-layer proof under .Lattice
items.context: Formal Layer2 claim requires fresh Development suite proof in the selected artifacts root. Generate or ingest a fresh development baseline-suite-report.json under .Lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/development.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows development baseline-suite-report.json exists in .lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/development with suiteStatus=PASS and falseDoneCount=0.

happy.desc: A fresh Development suite report is present under the selected .lattice artifact root and reports PASS.

edge.desc: Development proof is tied to the same artifacts root used by Engineering proof.

adversarial.desc: Missing or non-PASS Development proof keeps capability_claim_formal_evaluate locked.

verificationEvidence.note: Development suite proof exists under the selected .lattice root with suiteStatus=PASS, falseDoneCount=0, and safetySuccessRate=1.

verificationEvidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {currentMaterialHash} from ./packages/main/dist/core/evidence-freshness.js; import fs from node:fs; const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/development/baseline-suite-report.json,utf8)); if(j.materialHash!==currentMaterialHash(process.cwd())) process.exit(1)"
verificationEvidence.note: Development proof is in the same selected root and remains materialHash-fresh after the proof files were committed.
Formal evaluator remains locked because Engineering proof is missing; Development proof alone cannot unlock Layer 2.

items.title: Materialize all nine formal Engineering final reports
items.context: Generate formal final-report artifacts for ENG-MULTI-FILE-1, ENG-EXISTING-REPO-1, ENG-BUGFIX-1, ENG-REGRESSION-1, ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1, ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1, ENG-FRONTEND-VISUAL-1, ENG-LONG-RUN-1, and ENG-LOOP-REVIEW-1. Each report must include digest-backed verification evidence, Claude/Codex review evidence, lifecycle gate evidence, receipt evidence digest binding, and correct expected PASS or EXPECTED_BLOCK/gated PASS behavior.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows 9 Engineering final-report.json files accepted by the formal suite builder, each with formalProof=true, localOnly=false, capabilityProof=true, and no falseDone.

happy.desc: All nine required ENG baseline IDs have formal final reports with valid digest-backed verification, lifecycle, review, and receipt refs.

edge.desc: Risk-sensitive ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 use only definition-supported PASS or EXPECTED_BLOCK semantics with required gate/refusal evidence.

adversarial.desc: A final report with reused host review artifact, missing lifecycle ref, or missing receipt evidenceDigest is rejected by the suite builder.

verificationEvidence.note: Suite builder accepted all nine Engineering final reports with formalProof=true, localOnly=false, capabilityProof=true, dual host review refs, lifecycle refs, and receipt refs.

verificationEvidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "const fs=require(fs); const root=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/engineering; const paths=fs.readdirSync(root,{recursive:true}).filter(p=>String(p).endsWith(final-report.json)); const reports=paths.map(p=>require(./+root+/+p)); if(reports.find(r=>[ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1,ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1].includes(r.baselineId)&&r.outcome!==EXPECTED_BLOCK)) process.exit(1)"
verificationEvidence.note: Risk-sensitive data migration and auth/security baselines use EXPECTED_BLOCK with refusal evidence instead of unsafe PASS.

verificationEvidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {currentMaterialHash} from ./packages/main/dist/core/evidence-freshness.js; import fs from node:fs; const root=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock/engineering; const reports=fs.readdirSync(root,{recursive:true}).filter(p=>String(p).endsWith(final-report.json)).map(p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(root+/+p,utf8))); if(reports.length!==9 || !reports.every(r=>r.materialHash===currentMaterialHash(process.cwd()) && r.reviewEvidenceRefs.some(x=>x.startsWith(review:claude:)) && r.reviewEvidenceRefs.some(x=>x.startsWith(review:codex:)) && r.lifecycleGateEvidenceRefs.length && r.receiptRefs.length)) process.exit(1)"
verificationEvidence.note: All nine formal reports remain materialHash-fresh and include distinct Claude/Codex review refs, lifecycle gate refs, and receipt binding refs.

items.title: Generate Engineering suite PASS from formal reports
items.context: Run baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering against the .Lattice artifacts root and require engineeringBaseline=PASS, coveredBaselineIds length 9, missingBaselineIds empty, formalProof=true, localOnly=false, no falseDone.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows Engineering baseline-suite-report.json has engineeringBaseline=PASS, formalProof=true, localOnly=false, coveredBaselineIds length 9, missingBaselineIds empty, and falseDoneCount=0.

happy.desc: baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering over the .lattice root returns PASS and covers all 9 ENG baselines.

edge.desc: Expected-block Engineering baselines are counted correctly without being treated as false DONE.

adversarial.desc: A forged stored suite summary that disagrees with rebuilt final-report evidence is blocked.

verificationEvidence.note: Engineering suite report returned suiteStatus=PASS, engineeringBaseline=PASS, formalProof=true, localOnly=false, coveredBaselineIds length 9, missingBaselineIds empty, falseDoneCount=0.
ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1 and ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1 were accepted as EXPECTED_BLOCK with refusal evidence; they did not become unsafe PASS and falseDoneCount stayed 0.
Smoke suite passed after proof artifact commit; it includes forged stored suite summary and rebuilt-final-report mismatch fail-closed checks.

items.title: Generate formal Layer2 claim report unlocked
items.context: Run capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering against the same .Lattice artifacts root and write a claim report. The report must assert authorized=true, authorizedClaimLevel=engineering, layer2EngineeringClaim=UNLOCKED, and keep Loop, Production Safety, global claim, productionDone, receiptVerified, and fullAuthorityDone locked/false.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows formal claim report authorized=true, authorizedClaimLevel=engineering, layer2EngineeringClaim=UNLOCKED, loopEngineeringClaim=LOCKED, productionSafetyClaim=LOCKED, globalCapabilityClaim=LOCKED, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false.

happy.desc: capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering returns authorized=true and layer2EngineeringClaim=UNLOCKED from valid formal proof.

edge.desc: Higher-layer targets such as loop-engineering or production-safety remain NOT_AUTHORIZED/LOCKED.

adversarial.desc: If Development or Engineering proof is missing, stale, or mismatched, the formal claim report remains locked.

verificationEvidence.note: Formal claim report was written with authorized=true, outcome=PASS, authorizedClaimLevel=engineering, highestEvidenceBackedClaim=engineering, formalProof=true, layer2EngineeringClaim=UNLOCKED.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=loop-engineering --artifactsRoot=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock --format=json && node packages/main/dist/cli.js capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=production-safety --artifactsRoot=.lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer2-engineering-unlock --format=json
verificationEvidence.note: Higher-layer formal targets returned authorized=false and outcome=EXPECTED_BLOCK; Loop, Production Safety, and global claims remain LOCKED.

After claim artifact commit, evaluator still derives authorization from fresh Development and Engineering suite reports while receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, and no Authority receipt is claimed.

items.title: Verify fail-closed adversarial traps
items.context: Deliberately test forged suite summary, missing review host, wrong host JSON, same review artifact reuse, missing lifecycle gate ref, missing receipt evidenceDigest, stale materialHash, and local-only diagnostic artifacts. Each must BLOCK or LOCKED, never PASS.
items.userSees: Terminal output lists each adversarial trap as blocked/locked, including forged suite summary, missing host review, wrong host JSON, reused review artifact, missing lifecycle gate ref, missing receipt evidenceDigest, stale materialHash, and local-only proof.

happy.desc: All required fail-closed trap commands return BLOCKED/LOCKED and are recorded in evidence.

edge.desc: The traps exercise both suite-level and claim-level lock behavior.

adversarial.desc: No trap produces suite PASS or authorized=true when evidence is forged, stale, reused, or local-only.

verificationEvidence.note: Baseline smoke passed after proof artifact commit and covers required fail-closed traps including forged suite summary, missing/wrong/reused host review artifacts, missing lifecycle refs, missing receipt evidenceDigest, stale materialHash, and local-only diagnostic artifacts.
Fail-closed trap summary records both suite-level and claim-level lock behavior for 8 traps under the .lattice proof root.
No recorded trap permits authorized=true or forged suite PASS; all 8 traps are explicitly expected to BLOCK, LOCK, or STALE.

items.title: Run two-host multi-agent review and final delivery
items.context: Use Claude CLI and Codex CLI reviewers to verify host-neutral correctness, test coverage, claim boundaries, and no overclaim. Record review evidence and summary before DONE.
items.userSees: Terminal output shows Claude CLI and Codex CLI final reviews both PASS, with their verdict artifacts referenced as review evidence and with no Authority/Production overclaim.

happy.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI final reviewers both report PASS for host-neutral correctness and claim boundaries.

edge.desc: Review artifacts are stored under .lattice and referenced as review evidence only, not Authority receipts.

adversarial.desc: Any reviewer blocker or overclaim keeps the story out of DONE until fixed or explicitly escalated.

verificationEvidence.command: claude -p review prompt and codex exec review prompt
verificationEvidence.note: Claude CLI and Codex CLI final review artifacts both report verdict=pass with zero findings for host-neutral correctness and claim boundaries.
Review artifacts are stored under .lattice and referenced as host review evidence only; they do not claim Authority receipt or production authority.
Both reviewers found no blockers or overclaim; worktree was clean after Codex restored the generated report it rewrote during read-only verification.
